nodes.label: JII Architecture Decision Records
AI Handoff Policy / repo as single source of truth
nodes.rationale: All knowledge to continue development lives in the repo so any agent (AI or human) can continue with minimal context loss; no important knowledge may live only in a chat window.

nodes.label: ADR-0001 Single Cargo crate, not a workspace
nodes.rationale: MVP is small; a workspace adds coordination overhead without payoff. Modular layout gives needed separation; a future crate split stays possible because modules respect clean boundaries.

nodes.label: ADR-0002 JSON state file, not SQLite
nodes.rationale: Registry records intentions verified against the real manager, so it is a small hint store; JSON is dependency-light and human-inspectable. SQLite migration later stays behind the same Registry API.

nodes.label: ADR-0003 Plan is a first-class, previewable concept
nodes.rationale: Transparency/safety are core values: every action builds an InstallPlan before touching the system; --dry-run renders it. Providers express everything as declarative Actions and never side-effect during planning.

nodes.label: ADR-0004 The core never branches on the source
nodes.rationale: All source-specific logic lives behind the Provider trait; no 'if source == dnf'. Keeps the system open for extension, closed for modification. Load-bearing invariant.

nodes.label: ADR-0005 JII is never fully run as root
nodes.rationale: Least privilege: only concrete privileged steps escalate via sudo/pkexec, batched, shown first; escalation lives solely in privilege.rs. Providers plan but never execute privileged actions.

nodes.label: ADR-0006 Trust levels drive consent; default_yes is a threshold
nodes.rationale: Auto-confirm is a trust threshold (default_yes_max_trust), not a global boolean; untrusted is always explicitly confirmed even under --auto. A single global yes would silently install arbitrary binaries.

nodes.label: ADR-0007 Expressive execution model: Action enum + plan executor
nodes.rationale: Replace argv-only Step with an Action enum (RunCommand/Download/Place/RemoveFile) + exec.rs; Download enforces Verification. GitHub Releases needs download->verify->place which argv-only cannot express. Supersedes the original Step.

nodes.label: ADR-0008 COPR grouped with GitHub in Phase 4
nodes.rationale: dnf5 copr has no search, so resolving which COPR provides a package needs the COPR web API — the same fuzzy name->source resolution problem as GitHub, plus root repo-enable and trust; they belong together.

nodes.label: ADR-0009 PkgVersion(String) instead of semver::Version
nodes.rationale: Sources are heterogeneous (RPM EVR, GitHub tags, Flatpak scheme); semver cannot parse EVR. Opaque newtype preserves fidelity; cross-source comparison deferred to when a freshness tie-breaker needs it.

nodes.label: ADR-0010 Parallel search, per-source timeouts, stale-on-error cache
nodes.rationale: Fan-out all providers concurrently, each bounded by a timeout; cache with TTL, serve stale on error, tag failed sources. One slow/offline source must not block or fail the others — graceful degradation beats all-or-nothing.

nodes.label: ADR-0011 Repository is the single source of truth; AI-agnostic handoff
nodes.rationale: All continuation knowledge lives in the repo (ARCHITECTURE/ROADMAP/TASKS/DECISIONS/AI_CONTEXT); conversation context is ephemeral. Every session ends by updating docs and committing.

nodes.label: ADR-0012 Machine-readable tool output; pure, unit-tested parsers
nodes.rationale: Drive tools in machine mode (dnf5 --queryformat, flatpak --columns) and parse structured output in pure functions unit-tested on fixed samples; human output is unstable across versions/locales.

nodes.label: ADR-0013 Minimal CI enforces the DoD; other infra deferred
nodes.rationale: CI runs clippy -D warnings + tests --locked, plus Dependabot and .editorconfig; deliberately skip rustfmt gate, toolchain file, SECURITY/CONTRIBUTING, deny.toml, release workflow until they pay off (public/release).

nodes.label: ADR-0014 GitHub provider: owner/repo queries, network in search, raw binaries first
nodes.rationale: Resolve owner/repo to latest release; do all network in search and embed URL/sha into raw so plan_install is pure; select a raw exe asset (musl>gnu), Download->Place into ~/.local/bin, classify untrusted.

nodes.label: ADR-0015 Frontend-agnostic engine; frontends stay thin
nodes.rationale: All business logic lives in the engine; frontends parse input, call the engine, render. A GUI reimplementing ranking/trust would drift and split the security model. One engine, many thin frontends.

nodes.label: ADR-0016 Action::Extract: locate binary by name, .tar.gz first
nodes.rationale: Add Extract{archive,member,dest,mode}; extract by binary name (sole-executable fallback) since tarball layouts vary and search must stay network-free. Verify before extract. Later .zip added, format seam confirmed.

nodes.label: ADR-0017 COPR provider: exact project-name match, two-step root plan
nodes.rationale: Resolve query to the COPR project whose name equals the query and builds for host chroot; plan the two privileged steps (copr enable, install) at community trust. Exact match keeps the install target known/unambiguous.

nodes.label: ADR-0018 jii audit: record verification at install time
nodes.rationale: Add verification:Option<String> to InstalledRecord set from the plan's Download step; None means manager-verified (dnf/copr GPG, flatpak). Record provenance, don't guess it; engine computes audit, CLI renders.

nodes.label: ADR-0019 jii doctor health: providers probe, engine judges
nodes.rationale: Provider::probe reports facts (reachable, rate_limited, detail); engine maps to Health via pure health_from (Offline>RateLimited>Slow>Healthy). Rate limit is a real GitHub failure mode the user must see.

nodes.label: ADR-0020 JII is a universal layer, not another package manager
nodes.rationale: JII unifies existing sources via their native mechanisms (search/choose/trust/install/manage); it never becomes a package manager, invents a format, or hosts an archive. The test: does it help users without making the architecture heavier?

nodes.label: ADR-0021 Integrate external backends only through their stable public API
nodes.rationale: An external project (motivating case UPAC/libupac) is integrated only via its published, versioned API, modelled as another Provider; if the API doesn't exist yet, JII implements nothing (design on paper).

nodes.label: ADR-0022 Phase 5 readiness: grow via optional Provider capabilities; keep engine UI-free
nodes.rationale: New capabilities are optional Provider methods with safe defaults (never a fat trait, never core branching); engine stays UI-free (decouple the Renderer seam before a second frontend); versions/metadata/rollback live in provider or registry.

nodes.label: ADR-0023 Program-vs-library detection is best-effort per provider
nodes.rationale: Filter library-only packages when the registry exposes it reliably (cargo bin_names, npm bin); otherwise offer and let the tool be the authority (pipx/go). A visible false positive is safer than silently hiding a real app.

nodes.label: ADR-0024 8-provider review: no changes warranted; Homebrew next
nodes.rationale: After 8 providers the architecture is healthy and needs no code change; two non-blocking debts recorded (version comparison, cli/mod.rs size); Homebrew is the next provider and the test point for a shared RegistryProvider scaffold.

nodes.label: ADR-0025 Batch install via optional plan_install_many + engine grouping
nodes.rationale: Batch fits with no InstallPlan/Executor change: optional plan_install_many merges same-source installs, engine groups by source and primes privilege once. Single install becomes a batch of one; batch trust = least-trusted candidate.

nodes.label: ADR-0026 Terminal 1.0: complete the CLI before Beta; grow via optional capabilities
nodes.rationale: Deliver CLI 1.0 as ordered tracks T1-T8 (read-only honesty, batch symmetry, provider breadth, cross-distro, choosers, bootstrap, hardening, polish); a promotion into an ordered plan, not a redesign. Commits three minimal optional/data-driven growths.

nodes.label: ADR-0027 No shared RegistryProvider scaffold after five providers
nodes.rationale: Measured against 5 real registry providers, only ~8 boilerplate lines are identical; everything substantive (search/plan/list) is irreducibly per-provider. Shared logic already lives in free functions. Reduce maintenance cost, not line count.

nodes.label: ADR-0028 AppImage is a GitHub-release asset kind, not a standalone provider
nodes.rationale: AppImage has no manager/search API; installing one is download+place+chmod, which github already does. github::classify accepts .AppImage; by-name discovery folds into T5 repo chooser. Reuse seams, don't force a Provider.

nodes.label: ADR-0029 Platform seam: Platform is host facts; 'supported' = >=1 usable source in the engine
nodes.rationale: Remove is_supported/require_supported from Platform (pure host facts, no policy); redefine 'supported' as any usable source and move it to the engine; distro identity becomes an id/id_like predicate introduced on first use. Core stays O(1) in distros and managers.

nodes.label: ADR-0030 GitHub by-name discovery: search resolves cheaply, releases lazily at plan time
nodes.rationale: Bare-name github search does one cheap /search/repositories call returning K lightweight candidates; plan_install resolves the release lazily, spending a core-budget GET only for the repo actually installed. No engine branch on source. Deferred pending UX pass.

nodes.label: ADR-0031 The JII package spec name[:source][@ref] is the language of JII
nodes.rationale: Package-belonging attributes (source, version/channel) extend PackageSpec, not the flag set; @ref is source-interpreted (core never interprets it). The durable rule: 'does this belong to the package or the command?' Pure unit-tested parser, clap untouched.

nodes.label: ADR-0032 Actionable errors: a pure JiiError::remedy()
nodes.rationale: A pure remedy() maps typed errors to a concrete next step, unit-tested; Other(_) returns None to avoid fragile string-sniffing. Rendered in main.rs::report because the config case fails before a renderer exists.

nodes.label: ADR-0033 The recommend-catalog is a data subsystem, distro-filtered, read-only
nodes.rationale: Model recommendations as embedded TOML data with declared distro ids (Distro::id filter, not branching); read-only Analyze->Explain, entries resolve to normal JII specs. Amended by ADR-0035 (folded into doctor).

nodes.label: ADR-0034 System-wide update via optional plan_update_all
nodes.rationale: Bare jii update aggregates every provider's optional plan_update_all into one previewable run, plus a per-record fallback for sources with no bulk path; bulk plans aren't recorded (registry is a JII-install ledger, not a system inventory).

nodes.label: ADR-0035 doctor becomes the system helper; recommend folds in
nodes.rationale: doctor gains real host checks (internet, git/curl, PATH, Flathub) with pure unit-tested verdicts and --fix; the recommend catalog folds into doctor's tail and the standalone command is removed. Supersedes the surface of ADR-0033.

nodes.label: ADR-0036 jii providers: ecosystem marketplace; bootstrap via optional Provider::ecosystem
nodes.rationale: Ecosystem-ness is provider metadata (optional ecosystem() with a Bootstrap of Packages or Script); providers add lists managers and bootstraps a missing one via the normal install path (Packages) or shows the upstream script (never runs it).

nodes.label: ADR-0037 jii info is an app card; rich metadata via optional Provider::describe
nodes.rationale: A PackageInfo card via optional async describe() called only for the recommended candidate on jii info (never on search); dnf implements it fully, github cheaply. Rich metadata isn't on the hot search path.

nodes.label: ADR-0038 audit folds into jii list --audit
nodes.rationale: list and audit are two views of one ledger; jii list gains --audit and the standalone audit command is removed. Same fold-a-command-into-a-flag pattern as ADR-0035; no engine/model change.

nodes.label: ADR-0039 Distribution: prebuilt static-musl binaries + native packages
nodes.rationale: Static musl binaries (x86_64+aarch64) run on every distro; native .deb/.rpm via nfpm; install.sh one-liner with sha256 verify; completions/man via hidden subcommands. COPR/AUR scaffolding prepared, owner publishes. No user compile.

nodes.label: ADR-0040 JII self-update/uninstall: jii is a special name managing the tool itself
nodes.rationale: jii is reserved: update/remove/uninstall manage the tool itself; the mechanism follows how it was installed (atomic Action::Replace for user-space binaries, dnf/apt for packages). Different tag -> offer (versions opaque).

nodes.label: ADR-0041 jii doctor is an interactive setup questionnaire
nodes.rationale: Bare doctor walks actionable items as yes/no questions (default no) and applies on 'yes' (install, run documented command, or edit shell rc via Fix::PathExport). Reverses the earlier 'won't edit shell rc' boundary, only on explicit per-item consent.

nodes.label: ADR-0042 Search matching: exact-first, broaden on a miss
nodes.rationale: Exact search stays default; only on a miss broaden via prefix then a trailing-typo trim. MatchMode is a Query field honored per-provider; ranking is name-match-tier aware; a broadened match is never installed silently.

nodes.label: ADR-0043 Doctor analyses system state before suggesting
nodes.rationale: doctor gathers the installed set once (Engine::installed_index) and filters out already-done suggestions; each catalog entry declares a check id or derives from packages. Pure is_satisfied is unit-tested. Refines ADR-0041.

nodes.label: ADR-0044 Search speed: a per-source failure circuit breaker
nodes.rationale: A disk-persisted per-source failure table skips a source that failed within failure_cooldown_secs, serving stale cache; self-heals on cooldown or success. Persists to disk because each jii invocation builds a fresh Engine.

nodes.label: ADR-0045 info is a show, separate from install/search
nodes.rationale: Optional Provider::reference resolves an informational card from a name independent of installability; jii info calls it when the installable resolve found nothing. A library like lodash is describable even though JII won't install it as a program.

nodes.label: ADR-0046 A bare ecosystem-manager name installs the manager
nodes.rationale: jii npm routes a bare manager name to the bootstrap flow (install the manager), not a circular 'npm via npm'. A name counts as a manager only when unpinned; a route_managers loop-guard prevents re-entry.

nodes.label: ADR-0047 Nix list_installed: schema-tolerant nix profile list --json
nodes.rationale: Parse nix profile list --json tolerating both modern (map) and older (array) shapes via serde_json::Value; any garbage yields no records, never an error. Lets JII see non-jii Nix installs (cooperate with the system).

nodes.label: ADR-0048 Principle: JII cooperates with the system; not the centre of the world
nodes.rationale: Guiding principle: read real system state, the bare verb does the whole-system thing, install the manager not a package named after it, commands stay in their lane, cooperate don't clobber, core never branches on source. Points at ADR-0034/0040/0043/0045/0046/0047.

nodes.label: ADR-0049 Forge abstraction: GitHub is one Forge among peers
nodes.rationale: A Forge trait captures only host-specific bits (repo_url, latest_release, probe); a generic ForgeProvider owns forge-neutral asset selection, checksum and install plan. GitHub becomes GithubForge; Codeberg/Gitea/GitLab are a drop-in follow-up.

nodes.label: ADR-0050 Localization: keys in code, strings in locales/*.toml
nodes.rationale: Strings live in include_str!-embedded locales/en.toml/ru.toml referenced by dotted key via the t! macro; language resolves once (--lang > config > $LANG > English). English is the fallback; a parity test guards key sets.

nodes.label: ADR-0051 First-run setup runs before ANY command
nodes.rationale: Hoist the first-run wizard to the top of Cli::run so a first-ever task invocation (jii fastfetch) is greeted, then the typed command proceeds; non-interactive/--json/piped never trigger it. Setup should shape how the command behaves.

nodes.label: ADR-0052 Semantic colour palette + a mouse/keyboard chooser (crossterm)
nodes.rationale: A Copy Palette colours output only when the renderer's colour flag is on (pad before colouring); replace dialoguer with an inline crossterm menu supporting arrows and mouse, always restoring the terminal. Non-TTY/--json stay plain and take the default.

nodes.label: ADR-0053 By-name GitHub repo search: interactive picker over a forge capability
nodes.rationale: Optional Forge::search_repos (not a special case) surfaces top matches with a paging 'Show more'; a picked repo resolves like an explicit owner/repo into the normal preview->confirm->install; local edit-distance-1 typo variants recover misses. Realises T5 chooser.

nodes.label: ADR-0054 Cross-platform expansion: cheap imperative providers first, Void added; declarative Nix snippet-first
nodes.rationale: Sequence cross-platform growth by risk (Void/Gentoo imperative first, declarative Nix later, Windows/macOS a separate epic). Optional install_strategies + StrategyKind offer declarative Nix targets only when detected; a declarative pick shows the snippet, installs nothing (Etap A).

nodes.label: ADR-0055 Recommend prerequisites: doctor enables a required repo before dependents
nodes.rationale: Model the dependency in catalog data (Recommendation.requires); a pure prerequisite() returns the repo (RPM Fusion) to enable first, with consent, before its dependents (codecs/VLC). Fixes the skip-then-fail dead-end.

nodes.label: ADR-0056 Declarative Nix Etap B: parser-driven auto-edit of a user-owned config
nodes.rationale: Auto-edit a user-owned home.nix only (no escalation): StrategyKind::EditFile with provider-precomputed content+diff; splice via rnix CST into original bytes (never reprint); diff->backup(.jii-bak)->write. Fall back to snippet when it can't confidently edit.

nodes.label: ADR-0057 Declarative install preference: prefer_declarative config + per-run flags
nodes.rationale: [install] prefer_declarative = ask|always|never (source-agnostic) plus --nix-config/--nix-imperative overrides route batch/scripted installs into the config edit; ask keeps the single-package menu, batch stays imperative to avoid a prompt-storm.

nodes.label: ADR-0058 Declarative Nix Etap C: privileged auto-edit of root-owned configuration.nix
nodes.rationale: EditFile grows needs_root; the CLI branches on the flag not the source, staging content in an O_EXCL temp then two explicit elevated cp commands via privilege.rs (backup + write), primed once, shown first. Closes the last declarative gap.

nodes.label: ADR-0059 install.sh native-package install (opt-in via auto), portable stays default
nodes.rationale: install.sh JII_METHOD=auto detects the native manager and asks (default native) only with a TTY+escalation; no TTY -> portable, no sudo. Native assets discovered from the release API and sha-verified. No surprise root in a curl|sh pipe.

nodes.label: ADR-0060 JII everywhere: prebuilt-binary recipes for more channels + crates.io metadata
nodes.rationale: Add per-channel packaging recipes (Homebrew, Alpine, Void, Gentoo, Nix) repacking the static-musl tarball, plus crates.io metadata for cargo install jii. All consume the existing binary with no new build infra; owner publishes each.

nodes.label: ADR-0061 GitHub strictly last + bootstrap an uninstalled source before it
nodes.rationale: Part A: github moves to the end of default priority. Part B: split can_search (often network-only) from is_available (CLI to install); an uninstalled source can still answer, tagging needs_bootstrap so the manager is offered first (jii obsidian -> Flatpak) instead of a raw GitHub binary.

nodes.label: ADR-0062 AUR provider (Arch-only) + merge jii providers into jii sources
nodes.rationale: An Arch-gated AUR provider (RPC v5, helper installs, needs_root=false) via Platform::arch_like; jii providers folds into jii sources with add/remove; removal reuses Bootstrap::Packages, refuses system managers, shows the exact elevated command default-no.

nodes.label: ADR-0063 Whole-system update: capture per-source output into a summary + parallel self-check
nodes.rationale: Bare jii update captures each bulk plan's output and renders one line per source via a source-agnostic summarize_update heuristic (no branch on source id); the newer-JII GitHub check runs in parallel. Less noise, scannable ledger; failures never swallowed.

nodes.label: ADR-0064 jii doctor shows only host-relevant sources + refresh metadata after enabling a repo
nodes.rationale: Factor a shared source_relevant(available||can_search||ecosystem) rule so doctor and sources agree (hide foreign native managers); after enabling a prereq repo, run a best-effort dnf5 makecache before installing dependents. Pure capability, no source-id branch.

nodes.label: ADR-0065 T6: bootstrap an uninstalled manager before its app instead of falling to GitHub
nodes.rationale: bootstrap_missing_managers (per distinct manager, asked once) sets up a Packages manager via install_inner, adds the Flathub remote idempotently, confirms it landed before keeping the app; a Script manager (brew/nix) is shown never run. github passes through.

nodes.label: ADR-0066 Owner testing round: usable-source bootstrap, consent to a manager's own script, visible progress
nodes.rationale: first_bootstrap_package resolves a manager only via an is_available source (pins pipx:dnf); brew/nix upstream scripts are now shown and run on explicit yes (never via --auto/--yes); a stderr Spinner over captured output shows progress; --run asks Provider::launch_command; jii providers removed.

hyperedges.label: Grow via optional Provider capabilities pattern
